title: Novel Leflunomide Analog, UTLOH-4e, Ameliorates Gouty Arthritis Induced by Monosodium Urate Via NF-kappaB/NLRP3 Signaling Pathway.
authors: Yuan, Tianmin; Chen, Shilong; Yin, Yifeng; Shaw, Jiajiu; Zeng, Jin; Li, Li; Song, Lei; Zhang, Yiguan; Yin, Zhujun; Zhao, Junning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究痛风性关节炎药物UTLOH-4e的抗炎机制，仅涉及分子对接评估药物与蛋白亲和力，无蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gouty arthritis (GA) is a common form of inflammatory arthritis caused by intra-articular deposition of monosodium urate (MSU) crystals; however, there is a tremendous lack of safe and effective therapy in the clinic. OBJECTIVE: The goal of this work was to investigate a novel leflunomide analogue, N-(2,4- dihydroxyphenyl)-5-methyl-1,2-oxazole-3-carboxamide (UTLOH-4e), for its potential to prevent/ treat gouty arthritis. METHODS: In this study, the anti-inflammatory activity of UTLOH-4e was evaluated by MSUinduced GA model in vivo and in vitro, and the molecular docking test was applied to estimate the affinity of UTLOH-4e/UTL-5g/b for MAPKs, NF-kappaB, and NLRP3. RESULTS: In vitro, UTLOH-4e (1~100 muM) treatment inhibited the inflammatory reaction with no obvious cytotoxicity in PMA-induced THP-1 macrophages exposed to MSU crystals for 24 h, involving the prominent decreased production and gene expression of IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IL-6. Western blot analyses demonstrated that UTLOH-4e (1~100 muM) significantly suppressed the activation of NLRP3 inflammasomes, NF-kappaB, and MAPK pathways. Furthermore, the data from the experiment on gouty rats induced by intra-articular injection of MSU crystal confirmed that UTLOH-4e markedly ameliorated rat paw swelling, articular synovium inflammation and reduced the concentration of IL-1beta and TNF-alpha in serum through down-regulating NLRP3 protein expression. CONCLUSION: These results manifested that UTLOH-4e ameliorates GA induced by MSU crystals, which contributes to the modulation of NF-kappaB/ NLRP3 signaling pathway, suggesting that UTLOH- 4e is a promising and potent drug candidate for the prevention and treatment of gouty arthritis.
abstract_zh: 背景：痛风性关节炎（GA）是一种由关节内单钠尿酸盐（MSU）晶体沉积引起的常见炎症性关节炎；然而，临床上严重缺乏安全有效的治疗方法。目的：本研究旨在探讨一种新型来氟米特类似物N-(2,4-二羟基苯基)-5-甲基-1,2-噁唑-3-甲酰胺（UTLOH-4e）在预防/治疗痛风性关节炎方面的潜力。方法：本研究通过体内和体外MSU诱导的GA模型评估UTLOH-4e的抗炎活性，并采用分子对接测试评估UTLOH-4e/UTL-5g/b与MAPKs、NF-kappaB和NLRP3的亲和力。结果：体外实验中，UTLOH-4e（1~100 μM）处理在PMA诱导的THP-1巨噬细胞暴露于MSU晶体24小时后，抑制了炎症反应且无明显细胞毒性，表现为IL-1β、TNF-α和IL-6的产生及基因表达显著降低。Western blot分析表明，UTLOH-4e（1~100 μM）显著抑制了NLRP3炎症小体、NF-kappaB和MAPK通路的激活。此外，通过关节内注射MSU晶体诱导的痛风大鼠实验数据证实，UTLOH-4e通过下调NLRP3蛋白表达，显著改善了大鼠足爪肿胀、关节滑膜炎症，并降低了血清中IL-1β和TNF-α的浓度。结论：这些结果表明，UTLOH-4e通过调节NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号通路改善MSU晶体诱导的GA，提示UTLOH-4e是预防和治疗痛风性关节炎的一种有前景且有效的候选药物。
